name: US Directionals
description: Pre- and postdirectionals in all eight directions, abbreviated, in full and with periods; both on one street; and directional words that are the street name. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
